## Ingredients
- 8 slices of sandwich bread
- 10 anchovy fillets
- 40 g butter
- 1 mozzarella
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Chop the anchovies into small pieces and slice the mozzarella.
2. Cut the bread slices diagonally in half, place them on the baking sheet lined with the appropriate paper, and grill them in the oven for a few minutes.
3. Spread them with butter, top with mozzarella, anchovy fillets, and season with pepper.
4. Pass the crostini under the grill again until the cheese begins to melt.
5. Serve the crostini hot from the oven.
